mandatory_s4_evidence: authorized pilot-site surveys and verified geotags
controlled video capture, hash-chain, manifest reconstruction, access-control and DMRV linkage tests
next_sequence: S4-E22.14 controlled video evidence integration test
global_pilot_policy: Global Lagos Nigeria is the reference/proof pilot. International grids inherit evidence semantics, not evidence values. Brazil remains deliberately anchor-pending.
production_claim_policy: Never promote forecast, modelled, calculated or estimated values to measured or verified without evidence.
reportability_policy: REPORTABLE means provenance, timestamp, coordinate, unit, methodology, quality and reconciliation rules pass; REPORTABLE does not mean MEASURED, VERIFIED or ANCHORED.
non_contradiction_policy: Claims require compatible time, space, units, methodology, provenance and quality. Material conflicts or unsupported promotion fail closed; sources are not blindly averaged.
live_feed_policy: Feed interfaces may be deployed before endpoints are supplied. Only documented provider transport capabilities may determine PUSH_STREAM. HTTP retrieval remains POLLING_API; historical datasets remain ARCHIVE_QUERY; video transport is separately classified.
premium_rainwater_policy: Premium status is evidence-linked to rainfall events, atmospheric conditions, collection conditions, first flush, future water-quality/QMS, batch, seal and custody. Geography or forecast alone cannot establish premium status.
blockchain_policy: Canonical evidence package -> SHA-256 evidence root -> supported network anchor -> verification registry. Blockchain anchoring provides integrity/auditability and does not manufacture environmental truth or constitute grant funding.
grant_strategy: Grant-funded work packages map capital to measurable geographic coverage, data access, telemetry, DMRV, ESG/GHG reporting, water-quality validation, dashboards, independent review and milestone acceptance.
implementation_note: S5 global pilot pages and architecture are now included while runtime feeds remain actualizable by later endpoint configuration. Brazil is intentionally pending anchor identity. Runtime provider/video evidence gates and physical field validation remain controlled production gates. The production execution guide and updated production map are now registered as the operational release reference.
